_comment: Add this entry to .mcp.json alongside ERPAVal's existing servers. Adjust ERPAVAL_ROOT to point at your checkout, and SYMSPEC_DOC to scope the server to a per-session graph file. The Bedrock model ids and effort level can be overridden via env at any time without restarting Claude Code. If you've installed symspec globally (npm i -g ./symspec-x.y.z.tgz), you can drop the `command`/`args` and use `"command": "symspec-mcp"` instead.
